§6Better Builder's Wands§f

§aPlacing blocks one at a time? That's medieval.§f
Building Wands let you place multiple blocks in a single click. More tiers, more blocks at once.

§b• Stone§f: §c5 blocks§f max, horizontal only.
§b• Iron§f: §c9 blocks§f max, toggle between horizontal and vertical.
§b• Diamond§f: Up to §c1,024 blocks§f, all direction modes available.
§b• Unbreakable§f: No durability, scales with damage value.

Cycle through build modes by right-clicking. Toggle fluid placement mode to replace water or other fluids instead of placing blocks.

The diamond and unbreakable wands have full directional control: horizontal, vertical, N-S, E-W, and no-lock for free placement in any direction.

§ePS:§f These are a lifesaver for building walls, roads, and large platforms. Once you use one, you'll never go back.
